## Professional Experience
- Senior Software Developer (2021–Present): Frontend engineering across client products in telecom-regulatory, payments, blockchain, supply-chain, EdTech, and mortgage-lending domains. Currently delivering high-fidelity design-system and responsive UI for fintech lending products.
- Senior Executive 3D Design, UNO Minda Groups (2019–2021): 3D modeling, engineering design, and specification analysis before transitioning to software development.

## Featured Projects

2. Finance Management Platform: Expense logging, multi-currency wallet tracking, and transaction categorization. Built with modern component architecture.
